doctype.title: <!DOCTYPE html> Document type
doctype.history: Declares the HTML document type and version.
doctype.tip: The <!DOCTYPE html> declaration defines the HTML version.
doctype.quiz: Which declaration sets the HTML document type?

html.title: <html> Root
html.tip: The <html> tag is the root element of an HTML document.
html.quiz: Which is the root element of HTML?

head.title: <head> Metadata
head.tip: The <head> tag is used to hold metadata for the HTML document.

title.title: <title> Title
title.tip: The <title> tag is used to define the title of the HTML document.
title.quiz: Which tag sets the page title?

meta.title: <meta> Metadata
meta.tip: The <meta> tag provides data about the HTML document that is not displayed on the page.
meta.quiz: Which tag sets metadata like viewport?

link.title: <link> External resource
link.tip: The <link> tag is used to link external resources like CSS.

style.title: <style> CSS
style.tip: The <style> tag is used to embed CSS styles within the HTML document.

script.title: <script> JS
script.tip: The <script> tag is used to embed client-side JavaScript within the HTML document.

body.title: <body> Document body
body.tip: The <body> tag is used to contain the visible content of the HTML document.

h1.title: <h1>–<h6> Headings
h1.tip: The <h1> to <h6> tags are used for headings, with <h1> being the most important and <h6> the least.

p.title: Paragraph
p.tip: The <p> tag is used to define a paragraph.

br.title: Line break
br.tip: The <br> tag is used to insert a line break in text.
br.quiz: Which tag inserts a line break?

hr.title: <hr> Horizontal rule
hr.tip: The <hr> tag is used to create a horizontal rule, which is a thematic break in the content.
hr.quiz: Which tag adds a thematic break?

a.title: <a> Anchor
a.tip: The <a> tag is used to create hyperlinks to other pages or resources.

abbr.title: <abbr> Abbreviation
abbr.tip: The <abbr> tag is used to define an abbreviation or acronym, providing a tooltip with the full term.
abbr.quiz: Which tag shows a tooltip for abbreviation?

b.title: <b> Bold
b.tip: The <b> tag is used to make text bold without implying any extra importance.
b.quiz: Which tag makes text bold without importance?

strong.title: <strong> Important
strong.tip: The <strong> tag is used to indicate that the text has strong importance.

i.title: <i> Italic
i.tip: The <i> tag is used to make text italic without implying any extra emphasis.

em.title: <em> Emphasis
em.tip: The <em> tag is used to indicate that the text has a different emphasis than the surrounding text.

mark.title: <mark> Highlight
mark.tip: The <mark> tag is used to highlight text for reference or emphasis.

small.title: <small> Small
small.tip: The <small> tag is used to reduce the font size of the text, often for fine print or disclaimers.

sub.title: <sub> Subscript
sub.tip: The <sub> tag is used to display text as subscript, typically for chemical formulas or mathematical expressions.

sup.title: <sup> Superscript
sup.tip: The <sup> tag is used to display text as superscript, typically for mathematical powers or footnotes.

code.title: <code> Code
code.tip: The <code> tag is used to display inline code snippets or programming code.

pre.title: <pre> Preformatted
pre.tip: The <pre> tag is used to display preformatted text, preserving whitespace and line breaks.

kbd.title: <kbd> Keyboard
kbd.tip: The <kbd> tag is used to indicate keyboard input or commands.

samp.title: <samp> Sample
samp.tip: The <samp> tag is used to indicate sample output from a program or system.

var.title: <var> Variable
var.tip: The <var> tag is used to indicate a variable in programming or mathematical expressions.

cite.title: <cite> Citation
cite.tip: The <cite> tag is used to indicate the title of a work, such as a book, article, or research paper.
cite.quiz: Which tag cites a work title?

q.title: <q> Quote
q.tip: The <q> tag is used to indicate a short inline quotation.
q.quiz: Which tag shows an inline quote?

blockquote.title: <blockquote> Block quote
blockquote.tip: The <blockquote> tag is used to indicate a longer quotation, typically displayed as a block.
blockquote.quiz: Which tag shows a block quote?

span.title: <span> Inline
span.tip: The <span> tag is a generic inline container for phrasing content, often used for styling purposes.
span.quiz: Which tag is a generic inline?

del.title: <del> Deleted
del.tip: The <del> tag is used to indicate text that has been deleted from a document.

ins.title: <ins> Inserted
ins.tip: The <ins> tag is used to indicate text that has been inserted into a document.

u.title: <u> Underline
u.tip: The <u> tag is used to underline text without implying any extra importance.

s.title: <s> Inaccurate
s.tip: The <s> tag is used to indicate text that is no longer accurate or relevant.

header.title: <header>
header.tip: The <header> tag is used to define a header for a document or section.

nav.title: <nav>
nav.tip: The <nav> tag is used to define a set of navigation links.

main.title: <main>
main.tip: The <main> tag is used to define the main content of a document.

section.title: <section>
section.tip: The <section> tag is used to define a standalone section in a document.

article.title: <article>
article.tip: The <article> tag is used to define independent, self-contained content.

aside.title: <aside>
aside.tip: The <aside> tag is used to define content that is tangentially related to the main content.

footer.title: <footer>
footer.tip: The <footer> tag is used to define a footer for a document or section.

address.title: <address>
address.tip: The <address> tag is used to provide contact information for the author or owner of a document.

time.title: <time>
time.tip: The <time> tag is used to define a date or time.

img.tip: The <img> tag is used to embed an image in a document.

audio.title: <audio>
audio.tip: The <audio> tag is used to embed audio content in a document.
audio.code: <audio controls><source src='assets/Believer.mp3' type='audio/mpeg'>Your browser does not support audio.</audio>

video.title: <video>
video.tip: The <video> tag is used to embed video content in a document.
video.code: <video controls><source src='movie.mp4' type='video/mp4'>Your browser does not support video.</video>

source.title: <source>
source.tip: The <source> tag is used to specify multiple media resources for media elements like

track.title: <track>
track.tip: The <track> tag is used to specify text tracks for media elements like
track.code:
<video controls>
  <source src='movie.mp4' type='video/mp4'>
  <track src='subtitles_en.vtt' kind='subtitles' srclang='en' label='English'>
</video>

map.title: <map>
map.tip: The <map> tag is used to define an image map.

area.title: <area>
area.tip: The <area> tag is used to define a clickable area within an image map.

figure.title: <figure>
figure.tip: The <figure> tag is used to define a standalone figure in a document.

figcaption.title: <figcaption>
figcaption.tip: The <figcaption> tag is used to define a caption for a figure.

canvas.title: <canvas>
canvas.tip: The <canvas> tag is used to create a drawing surface.
canvas.quiz: Which tag provides a drawing surface?

svg.title: <svg>
svg.tip: The <svg> tag is used to define vector graphics.
svg.code: <svg width='120' height='60'><circle cx='30' cy='30' r='20' fill='tomato'/></svg>

iframe.title: <iframe>
iframe.tip: The <iframe> tag is used to embed another HTML page.

embed.title: <embed>
embed.history:
The <embed> tag is a simple container used to insert external files like videos, flash games, or PDF documents directly into your webpage.
<embed type='video/mp4' src='my-videos' width='500' height='300'>
embed.tip: The <embed> tag is used to embed external content.

object.title: <object>
object.tip: The <object> tag is used to embed objects.

param.title: <param>
param.tip: The <param> tag is used to specify parameters for the
param.quiz: Which tag sets parameters for object?

ul.title: <ul>
ul.tip: The <ul> tag is used to define an unordered list.

ol.title: <ol>
ol.tip: The <ol> tag is used to define an ordered list.

li.title: <li>
li.tip: The <li> tag is used to define a list item.
li.quiz: Which tag defines a list item?

dl.title: <dl>
dl.tip: The <dl> tag is used to define a description list.

dt.title: <dt>
dt.tip: The <dt> tag is used to define a term in a description list.
dt.code:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <title>HTML Description Term Example</title>
</head>
<body>
  <dl>
 <!-- The <dt> tag defines the term/name in a description list -->
    <dt>Description Term</dt>
    <dd>This is the definition or description of the term above.</dd>
  </dl>

</body>
</html>

dd.title: <dd>
dd.tip: The <dd> tag is used to provide the definition, description, or explanation for the preceding term (<dt>) inside a description list.
dd.code:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <title>HTML Description Details Example</title>
</head>
<body>

  <dl>
    <dt>JavaScript</dt>
    <!-- The <dd> tag defines the description or definition of the term above -->
    <dd>A programming language used to make web pages interactive and dynamic.</dd>
  </dl>

</body>
</html>

form.title: <form>
form.tip: The <form> tag is used to create an HTML form.

input.title: <input>
input.tip: The <input> tag is used to create an input field.

textarea.title: <textarea>
textarea.tip: The <textarea> tag is used to create a multiline input field.

button.title: <button>
button.tip: The <button> tag is used to create a clickable button.

select.title: <select>
select.tip: The <select> tag is used to create a dropdown list.

optgroup.title: <optgroup>
optgroup.tip: The <optgroup> tag is used to group options in a dropdown list.

option.title: <option>
option.tip: The <option> tag is used to define an option in a dropdown list.

label.title: <label>
label.tip: The <label> tag is used to label an input field.

fieldset.title: <fieldset>
fieldset.tip: The <fieldset> tag is used to group related form elements.

legend.title: <legend>
legend.tip: The <legend> tag is used to title a fieldset.

datalist.title: <datalist>
datalist.tip: The <datalist> tag is used to provide a list of predefined options for an input field.

output.title: <output>
output.tip: The <output> tag is used to display the result of a calculation.
output.code: <form oninput='r.value=+a.value + +b.value'><input id='a' type='number'> + <input id='b' type='number'> = <output name='r'></output></form>

progress.title: <progress>
progress.tip: The <progress> tag is used to display the progress of a task.

meter.title: <meter>
meter.tip: The <meter> tag is used to display a scalar measurement within a known range.

table.title: <table>
table.tip: The <table> tag is used to create an HTML table.

caption.title: <caption>
caption.tip: The <caption> tag is used to title a table.

thead.title: <thead>
thead.tip: The <thead> tag is used to group header rows in a table.

tbody.title: <tbody>
tbody.tip: The <tbody> tag is used to group body rows in a table.

tfoot.title: <tfoot>
tfoot.tip: The <tfoot> tag is used to group footer rows in a table.

tr.title: <tr>
tr.tip: The <tr> tag is used to define a table row.
tr.quiz: Which tag defines a table row?

td.title: <td>
td.tip: The <td> tag is used to define a data cell.
td.quiz: Which tag defines a data cell?

th.title: <th>
th.tip: The <th> tag is used to define a header cell.
th.quiz: Which tag defines a header cell?

colgroup.title: <colgroup>
colgroup.tip: The <colgroup> tag is used to group columns in a table.

col.title: <col>
col.tip: The <col> tag is used to define column properties.

Modern: use CSS like font-size.

font.history: Inline font styling; replaced by CSS (font-family, color).
font.tip: The <font> tag is used for inline font styling; use CSS properties like color and font-family instead.
font.code:

This text uses the old <font> tag.

Modern: use CSS properties like color and font-family.
font.quiz: Which deprecated tag was used for inline font styling?

frame.title: <frame> (Deprecated)
frame.history: Part of the frameset model; avoid using frames in modern layouts.
frame.tip: The <frame> tag is used to define a single frame inside a frameset; use CSS or other modern layout techniques instead.
frame.code:

Frames are part of the old frameset model and are deprecated. Example shown as text only.

frameset.title: <frameset> (Deprecated)
frameset.history: Container for frames-based layouts; replaced by modern CSS layouts.
frameset.tip: The <frameset> tag is used to define a set of frames; use CSS or other modern layout techniques instead.
frameset.code:
<frameset> Example (Deprecated)

Frameset replaced <body> in old HTML to create frames. Do not use in modern pages.

Example concept: <frameset cols="25%,75%"> <frame src="nav.html"> <frame src="main.html"> </frameset>

isindex.history: Provided a single-line search prompt in very old HTML; replaced by forms and inputs.
isindex.tip: The <isindex> tag is used to provide a simple search input; use <form> and <input type="search"> instead.
isindex.code:

The <isindex> tag provided a single-line search prompt in very old HTML.

Modern: use <form> and <input type="search">.

keygen.history: Generated client-side keys for certificates; deprecated for security and compatibility reasons.

keygen.code:

Old usage: <keygen name="key"> to generate client keys. Deprecated due to security and browser support.

Modern alternatives: use Web Crypto APIs or server-side key handling.
keygen.quiz: Which deprecated tag was used for client-side key generation?

menuitem.history: Intended for context menu items; had limited support and is deprecated.
menuitem.tip: The <menuitem> tag is used to represent an item in a context menu; deprecated for limited support.
menuitem.code:

The <menuitem> element was intended for context menus but had poor support.

Use custom context menus via JavaScript and ARIA for accessibility.
menuitem.quiz: Which deprecated tag represented a context menu item?

Scrolling text using <marquee> (deprecated)

The <noembed> element provided fallback for embedded content in very old browsers.

spacer.title: <spacer> (Deprecated)

Modern: use margin or padding.

Teletype monospace text
